subject: B1 V3 constraint interaction summary
source: Phase 14B remove-two and remove-three results (avg across 3 windows)
interaction_metric_definition: interact_PF = observed_pair_d_PF - (single_A_d_PF + single_B_d_PF). Negative => sub-additive => constraint geometry. Positive => super-additive (substitutive). Same for sharpe and jaccard.

top_negative_pair_interactions.interpretation: F is harmless alone; A_J_range is anti-alpha alone; pair is strongly damaging. Geometry hub interaction.
Canonical conditional-activation: B_KltD dead alone (Jac 1.000) but its joint removal with A_J_range collapses PF below additive.
Two independent concentrators whose joint removal damages PF more than their sum but Sharpe stays neutral due to E's standalone Sharpe lift in B window.

top_negative_triple_interactions.interpretation: Largest 3-way negative interaction; exceeds top pair (-1.02). Proves effective dimension of constraint geometry >= 3.

interactions_outside_high_impact_5_known.interpretation: Strong redundancy: removing both individually appears beneficial but joint behaviour collapses. Different scale because Phase 11 used different definition of 'removal' (parameter relaxation rather than disable).

evidence: Top 3 negative pairs all include A_J_range
5 of 5 strongest negative triples include A_J_range

key_finding: B1 V3 alpha lives in a constraint polytope with effective dimension >= 3. A_J_range is the structural spine. Single-component analyses systematically under-estimate the system's complexity by approximately one order of magnitude.
